title: Domestic Employee Travel Reimbursement Policy
text: The standard travel reimbursement rule covers economy airfare, lodging within company-approved per-diem limits, and standard meal allowances for employee trips. All expense claims must be filed through the corporate finance portal within 30 days of trip conclusion with digitized tax invoices.

title: Post-Travel and Late Booking Exception Policy
text: Reservations must normally be booked at least 14 days in advance via the self-service travel desk. In cases where bookings are made after travel has commenced or retroactive ticket issuance occurs, the late-booking exception requires senior director approval alongside formal justification of business exigency.

title: International Travel and Foreign Currency Expense Guidelines
text: For international employee travel, the standard reimbursement rule still applies to base accommodations and fares. However, international travel introduces a mandatory foreign currency receipt verification requirement, requiring conversion slips or credit card statements indicating the prevailing exchange rate on the transaction date.

title: Visa and Passport Processing Fees
text: Expedited visa processing, embassy consular fees, and mandatory travel health insurance are 100% reimbursable for verified overseas client assignments.
